description: Answers a call time for a request. 'accept' confirms the time a developer proposed, or the new time a developer asked for. 'decline' says it does not work: before the call is booked another developer is asked, afterwards the booked time stays. 'propose_other_time' suggests a new time for a booked call; the developer is emailed and answers. Times are shown in the user's own time zone; new times are ISO 8601 with an offset.

task_id.description: The request the call is for.

time.description: Only for propose_other_time: the new start as ISO 8601 with an offset, for example 2026-11-12T15:00:00+01:00.

name: respond_to_call_time
title: Answer a call time
